Also physical properties: colorless, odorless, tasteless gas at STP, low density, high diffusivity, etc. Also chemical properties: reacts with oxygen to form water, forms hydrides, etc. Also nuclear properties: nuclear spin, magnetic moment. Also uses: fuel, rocket propellant, etc.
